vars.label: Population (survey estimate)
vars.definition: People living in the area, as estimated by the American Community Survey over five years. It differs from the Census count and from the yearly estimates of the Population Estimates Program, which have no margin of error and exist only for municipalities.

vars.label: People under 18, % of all people
vars.definition: Share of the people of the area who are under 18 years old.

vars.label: People 65 and older, % of all people
vars.definition: Share of the people of the area who are 65 years old or older.

vars.label: Children under 3, % of all people
vars.definition: Children under 3 years old who live in households, as a share of all the people of the area. The survey gives this age group only for children in households (table B09001), so the few in group quarters are left out.

vars.label: Children aged 3 and 4, % of all people
vars.definition: Children aged 3 or 4 who live in households, as a share of all the people of the area (table B09001, households only).

vars.label: People aged 5 to 17, % of all people
vars.definition: Share of the people of the area who are 5 to 17 years old.

vars.label: People aged 18 to 24, % of all people
vars.definition: Share of the people of the area who are 18 to 24 years old.

vars.label: People aged 25 to 44, % of all people
vars.definition: Share of the people of the area who are 25 to 44 years old.

vars.label: People aged 45 to 64, % of all people
vars.definition: Share of the people of the area who are 45 to 64 years old.

vars.label: People aged 18 to 44, % of all people
vars.definition: Share of the people of the area who are 18 to 44 years old: the age group published for barrios and census tracts in place of 18 to 24 and 25 to 44, which are too rough there.

vars.label: Children under 3 (in households)
vars.definition: Children under 3 years old who live in households (table B09001, households only: the few in group quarters are left out).

vars.label: Children aged 3 and 4 (in households)
vars.definition: Children aged 3 or 4 who live in households (table B09001, households only).

vars.label: People aged 5 to 17
vars.definition: People of the area who are 5 to 17 years old.

vars.label: People aged 18 to 24
vars.definition: People of the area who are 18 to 24 years old.

vars.label: People aged 25 to 44
vars.definition: People of the area who are 25 to 44 years old.

vars.label: People aged 45 to 64
vars.definition: People of the area who are 45 to 64 years old.

vars.label: People 65 and older
vars.definition: People of the area who are 65 years old or older.

vars.label: People under 18
vars.definition: People of the area who are under 18 years old.

vars.label: People aged 18 to 44
vars.definition: People of the area who are 18 to 44 years old: the age group published for barrios and census tracts in place of 18 to 24 and 25 to 44, which are too rough there.

vars.label: Women and girls, % of all people
vars.definition: Share of the people of the area who are female.

vars.label: Family households, % of all households
vars.definition: Share of households that are family households: the householder lives with at least one relative.

vars.label: One-person households, % of all households
vars.definition: Share of households in which the householder lives alone.

vars.label: Veterans, % of civilians 18 and older
vars.definition: Share of civilians 18 and older who are veterans.

vars.label: People without health insurance, % of people outside institutions
vars.definition: Share of the civilian population living outside institutions who have no health insurance coverage of any kind (private or public: employer, direct purchase, Medicare, Medicaid or Plan Vital, military or VA), as the survey asks.

vars.label: Adults 25+ without a high school diploma, % of adults 25+
vars.definition: Share of adults 25 and older whose highest schooling is below a high school diploma or its equivalent (no schooling up to 12th grade without a diploma).

vars.label: People with a disability, % of people outside institutions
vars.definition: Share of the civilian population living outside institutions who have a disability (hearing, vision, cognitive, walking, self-care or independent-living difficulty, as the survey asks).

vars.label: People who speak English less than "very well", % of people 5 and older
vars.definition: Share of people 5 and older who speak a language other than English at home and say they speak English "well", "not well" or "not at all". The rest speak only English at home or say they speak English "very well". The answer is the person's own rating, not a test.

vars.label: Households that received nutrition assistance (PAN), % of all households
vars.definition: Share of households in which someone received benefits of the Programa de Asistencia Nutricional (PAN) in the past 12 months. The Census Bureau's table calls it Food Stamps/SNAP; in Puerto Rico the survey asks about the PAN.

vars.label: Children under 18 below the poverty level, % of children under 18
vars.definition: Share of children under 18 whose family income in the past 12 months was below the federal poverty level, among the children for whom the survey determines poverty status.

vars.label: People 65 and older below the poverty level, % of people 65 and older
vars.definition: Share of people 65 and older whose income in the past 12 months was below the federal poverty level, among those for whom the survey determines poverty status.
